scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && vite build
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrate && wrangler dev --port 8788
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

PASSWORD.description: The password to sign in to your app builder, 12 characters or more.

DB.description: Where the builder keeps your GitHub connection and your apps list.
